DocPage.title: Cloudmark Quick Start
DocPage.description: Cross-device, cross-browser cloud bookmark management tool

intro.title: What is Cloudmark?
intro.description: Cloudmark is a cloud-based bookmark collection tool that allows you to save and organize web bookmarks with one click and access them from any device. Write operations require a secret write token for security.

features.title: Key Features
features.cloud: Cloud storage (Cloudflare D1) for cross-device access
features.categories: Organize and filter bookmarks by categories

markName.title: Set Your Bookmark Name
markName.description: This name will be used for your bookmark collection and can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (4–64 characters).

writeToken.title: Your Write Token
writeToken.description: This secret token is required for all write operations (add, edit, delete). It is stored only in your browser and embedded in the bookmarklet. Keep it private.
writeToken.hint: The token is saved in this browser automatically. Copy it if you need another device or browser.
writeToken.regenerateConfirm: Regenerate token? The old one will only remain if you already copied it.
writeToken.backupHint: Download a backup file before closing this page — tokens cannot be recovered from the server.

bookmarklet.title: Install Bookmark Tool
bookmarklet.description: Drag the button above to your browser's bookmark bar. The bookmarklet includes your write token so saves are authenticated.

setup.title: Set Up Your Bookmarklet
setup.description: Create your collection name and write token, then add the bookmarklet to your browser's bookmark bar. The first successful save claims the collection with your token.

save.title: Save Webpages to Your Collection
save.description: When browsing a webpage, click the Cloudmark bookmarklet in your bookmark bar to save it. Old bookmarklets without a token will no longer work.

access.title: Access Your Bookmark Collection
access.description: Access {baseUrl}/{mark} to view and manage all your saved bookmarks. You can access this URL from any device or browser. Writing requires the write token on that device.

manage.title: Organize and Manage Your Bookmarks
manage.description: You can edit or delete bookmarks and change categories. If you migrate from an older version, follow the on-page banner to save your new token and reinstall the bookmarklet.

demo.title: Want to Experience Cloudmark?
demo.description: Try all the features of Cloudmark without creating a bookmark collection

BookmarksPage.title: Bookmarks
BookmarksPage.bookmarkletTip: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar to save pages with one click
BookmarksPage.demoDescription: This is a demo collection. You can freely explore the UI. Changes are not saved to the server.

notifications.tokenRequired: Write token is required. Update your bookmarklet.

SecurityBanner.migratedTitle: Collection migrated — save your write token
SecurityBanner.migratedDescription: Your bookmarks were moved from legacy storage to D1. A new write token was issued. Copy it and reinstall the bookmarklet below, then you can dismiss this banner.
SecurityBanner.updateDescription: Writes now require a write token. Use the new bookmarklet below so one-click saves keep working.
SecurityBanner.tokenRequiredDescription: This collection is protected. Paste your write token to enable add/edit/delete and the bookmarklet on this device.
SecurityBanner.pasteHint: If you just migrated on another device, copy the token from there. Or open Quick Start to create a new collection.
SecurityBanner.generateHint: For a new collection: generate a token here, then add your first bookmark to claim it. Do not generate a new token if this collection already has an owner — that will not unlock it.
SecurityBanner.tokenWarning: Anyone with this token can modify your collection. Do not share it publicly.
SecurityBanner.bookmarkletHint: Drag the button to your bookmarks bar, or replace the old bookmarklet. Old bookmarklets without a token will fail.

TokenManager.title: Write token
TokenManager.description: Manage the secret write token for collection {mark}. Losing it means you cannot edit this collection from this device.
TokenManager.tokenWarning: Anyone with this token can modify your collection. Never share it publicly.
TokenManager.bookmarkletHint: Drag to the bookmarks bar, or replace the old bookmarklet after rotating.
TokenManager.noToken: No write token on this device. Paste one from another device, or generate one for a new collection.
TokenManager.generateLocalHint: Generating a new local token does not unlock a collection you do not own. Use Rotate to change the server token safely.
TokenManager.pasteDescription: Paste a write token or load a recovery file you saved earlier.
TokenManager.invalidRecoveryFile: Could not read a token from that file
TokenManager.recoveryLoaded: Token loaded from file — review and save
TokenManager.markMismatch: File is for mark “{fileMark}”, this page is “{mark}”
TokenManager.mustBackup: Confirm you have backed up the token first
TokenManager.claimHint: Add a bookmark or use the bookmarklet to claim a new collection with this token.
TokenManager.needCurrentToken: You need the current token before rotating
TokenManager.reinstallBookmarklet: Reinstall the bookmarklet — the old one no longer works
TokenManager.cleared: Token removed from this device (server unchanged)
TokenManager.generateLocalWarning: This only stores a new token locally. It will NOT change the server. If the collection already has an owner, writes will fail until you paste the correct token.
TokenManager.generateNewWarning: Save this token before continuing. Cloudmark cannot recover it if you lose it.
TokenManager.rotatePoint1: The current token stops working immediately after rotation
TokenManager.rotatePoint2: You must download/copy the new token before finishing
TokenManager.rotatePoint3: Reinstall the bookmarklet on every device
TokenManager.rotateBackupWarning: Rotation succeeded. Back up the new token now — this is your only chance to see it here.
TokenManager.mustFinishRotateBackup: Finish backup first — the server already uses the new token
TokenManager.clearWarning: Remove the token from this browser only. The collection on the server is unchanged. You will need to paste the token again to write.
TokenManager.ackBackup: I have downloaded or copied this token to a safe place

ImportExport.title: Import / Export
ImportExport.description: Export for browser import, or import HTML/JSON bookmark files.
ImportExport.exportHtmlNote: HTML uses the Netscape format — Chrome / Firefox / Safari / Edge can import it via their bookmark manager.
ImportExport.importHint: Supports browser bookmark HTML exports and Cloudmark JSON. Folders become categories. Duplicates are skipped.
